title: PocketBase is the source of truth for task execution state
body: When MISSION_CONTROL.md and PocketBase disagree, query PocketBase to resolve. MISSION_CONTROL.md is human-readable context; PocketBase is the live execution layer. A task approved in Markdown but peer_review in PocketBase is still in peer_review.
source_ref: rules.md:R04; DUAL_SYSTEM.md; lessons — 'MISSION_CONTROL vs PocketBase sync discrepancy' (8+ instances)
